title: React Native Mobile Development
shortDescription: Build powerful, cross-platform mobile applications for iOS and Android using React Native with native performance and seamless user experience.

children.text: Create stunning mobile applications that run flawlessly on both iOS and Android platforms using React Native. I specialize in building high-performance, native-feeling apps that leverage device capabilities while maintaining a single codebase for maximum efficiency and cost-effectiveness.

: React Native allows me to deliver native performance and access to device features while sharing up to 95% of code between platforms, significantly reducing development time and costs compared to building separate native apps.
From concept to deployment, I handle the entire mobile app development lifecycle including UI/UX design, backend integration, API development, testing, and App Store/Play Store deployment.

features: Cross-platform iOS & Android apps with single codebase
Camera, GPS, and device hardware integration
App Store and Google Play Store deployment
Scalable backend integration with REST/GraphQL APIs
